calm.de: Heid is a guada Obend, gell?
Da Brunna host scho gseng? Staubi is er.
calm.en: Have you seen the well? Dusty, it is.

calm.de: Mei Oide sagt, s Brot werd teia.
calm.en: My wife says bread is getting dear.

calm.de: Morgn miass ma fria auf, Hans.
calm.en: Tomorrow we must rise early, Hans.

calm.de: Nix is los, nur da Wind.
calm.en: Nothing's going on, only the wind.

worried.de: Host des ghert? Draußn hod si wos grührt.
worried.en: Did you hear that? Something stirred outside.

worried.de: I mog net, dass d Kerzn so flackert.
worried.en: I don't like how the candle flickers.

worried.de: Seit gestern is mir net wohl.

whisper.de: Des san d Bluadsauger, i sag da s.
whisper.en: It's the bloodsuckers, I tell you.

calm.en: Have you any lard for the bread?

calm.de: Wo is denn da Pfarrer heid?
Kimmst no auf a Bier eina?
calm.en: Coming in for one more beer?

worried.de: Wos woar des fia a Gschrei?
worried.en: What kind of scream was that?

worried.de: Host d Tür aa guad versperrt?
worried.en: Did you lock the door properly?

calm.de: Du Depp, des is mei Platz!
calm.en: You fool, that is my seat!

worried.de: Hätt i auf mei Muatta ghört!
worried.en: I should have listened to my mother!

whisper.de: Sei staad, sunst hert ma uns!
whisper.en: Be quiet, or they'll hear us!

worried.de: Hehe, sei froh, dass nix passiert is.

calm.de: Oiso, oiso, wia ma s nimmt...
calm.en: Well, well, as one takes it...

worried.de: Es wird scho wieda, es wird scho...
worried.en: It will be all right, it will...

worried.de: Wenn s nur da Morgn war...

whisper.de: Gott schütz uns, Gott schütz uns...
whisper.en: God shield us, God shield us...
Don't look round... don't look round...

whisper.de: Es is do... i spier s...
whisper.en: It is here... I feel it...

calm.de: Servus, na, ja, du aa do?

calm.en: Jesus! You gave me a fright!
Stand still! In the bailiff's name!

worried.de: Hoit! Da is wer! Wer da?
worried.en: Halt! Someone is there! Who goes?

calm.de: Es hod zehne gschlogn, und olles ruhig!
calm.en: Ten has struck, and all is quiet!

calm.de: Zwöfe is s, und olles ruhig!
calm.en: It is twelve, and all is quiet!

calm.de: Oans is s, und olles ruhig!
calm.en: It is one, and all is quiet!
Three o'clock, and all is quiet!

worried.de: Do hod si wos grührt... Wer da?
Seids wachsam, es is net ruhig!
worried.en: Stay alert, it is not quiet!

calm.de: Da Teife! Da Teife is do!
calm.en: The devil! The devil is here!
Please, please, do not hurt me.

worried.de: I hob nix doa, i hob nix doa...
worried.en: I did nothing, I did nothing...

worried.de: Geh weg, geh weg, geh weg...
worried.en: Go away, go away, go away...

calm.de: Gott sei Dank, weg is er.

worried.de: Is er weg? Is er wirkli weg?
worried.en: Is it gone? Is it really gone?

calm.de: Moard! Do is a Moard gschehn!

worried.en: He is drained, drained of blood!

whisper.en: There... someone is lying there... quiet...

calm.de: Ja mei, so is des Lebn.
Wos da Tag ned olles bringt.

calm.en: Hmm, how late is it already?

worried.de: Heid is ma net wohl... gar net wohl.
worried.en: I am not well tonight... not well at all.

worried.de: S is zu staad im Dorf.

whisper.en: Did you hear it too? Shh...

whisper.de: Red leise, d Wänd ham Ohrn.
Geh liaba hoam, s is ned guad heid.
whisper.en: Better go home, it is not good tonight.

whisper.de: Pst... i hob wos gseng, bei da Kirch...
whisper.en: Shh... I saw something, by the church...

STRUGGLE_TIERS.de: Loss mi aus! Loss mi aus!
STRUGGLE_TIERS.en: Let me go! Let me go!

STRUGGLE_TIERS.de: Nehmt eich in Acht! A Bluadsauger!
Geh weg! Geh weg vo mir!
STRUGGLE_TIERS.en: Get away! Get away from me!
Holy Mother of God, help me...

STRUGGLE_TIERS.de: I hob a Frau dahoam, bitt...
STRUGGLE_TIERS.en: I have a wife at home, please...

farmer.de: D Ernte werd heuer mager, i sag s da.
farmer.en: The harvest will be lean this year, I tell you.

farmer.de: Da Weizn steht guad, wenn s net hagelt.
farmer.en: The wheat stands well, if it does not hail.

farmer.de: Mei Ochs hod scho wieda a Hax liahm.
farmer.en: My ox has gone lame in the leg again.

farmer.de: Morgn miass i fria raus aufs Fei.
farmer.en: Tomorrow I must be out in the field early.

farmer.de: Dea Reng kimmt, i spia s in de Knia.
farmer.en: Rain is coming, I feel it in my knees.

farmer.de: D Kia gebn kaum mehr Milch.
farmer.en: The cows hardly give any milk now.
The hay still has to dry.

farmer.de: Da Zehnt drückt mi, da Zehnt.
farmer.en: The tithe weighs on me, the tithe.

farmer.de: Hob a Wurzn ausgrobn, groß wia a Kopf.
farmer.en: Dug up a root as big as a head.

farmer.de: Im Wirtshaus gibts heid a frisches Bier.
farmer.en: There is fresh beer at the tavern tonight.

farmer.de: Mei Kreiz tuat weh vom Mähn.
Da Pfarrer sogt, mia sollns Feld segnen.
farmer.en: The priest says we should bless the field.

innkeeper.de: Zwoa Fassl Bier no, dann is Schluss.
innkeeper.en: Two more kegs of beer, then that is it.
Who pays for the crockery, who?
The guests get thirstier every day.
I must season the soup some more.

innkeeper.de: Mei Kellerin hod d Schlüssel valorn.
innkeeper.en: My cellar maid has lost the keys.

innkeeper.de: Da Wirt schaugt alles, da Wirt hert alles.
innkeeper.en: The innkeeper sees all, the innkeeper hears all.

innkeeper.de: Heid war da Hans scho wieda ohne Geld do.
innkeeper.en: Hans was here again without any money today.

innkeeper.de: Es Schmoiz werd a teia, wirkli.
innkeeper.en: Lard is getting dear too, really.

innkeeper.de: Wenn s so staad bleibt, sperr i bald zua.
innkeeper.en: If it stays this quiet I will close soon.

innkeeper.de: Da Bierdeckl is scho wieda feicht.
innkeeper.en: The coaster is damp again already.

innkeeper.de: Aa a Wirt braucht amoi seine Ruah.
innkeeper.en: Even an innkeeper needs his rest sometime.

innkeeper.de: Da Gockl vom Nachbarn is a Plog.
innkeeper.en: The neighbour's rooster is a plague.

priest.de: D Glockn miassat mal gschmiert wern.
D Leit kemma kaum mehr zur Messe.
priest.en: The people hardly come to Mass anymore.

priest.de: Wer d Beicht ned macht, schlaft schlecht.
Des Opferstockl is scho wieda leer.
priest.en: The alms box is empty again.

priest.de: Mir wor, i hob wos im Kirchhof gseng.
priest.en: I thought I saw something in the churchyard.

priest.de: Dominus vobiscum... a so a Wetta.

priest.en: The Mass wine keeps getting less.

priest.de: Gott prüft uns, gwiss prüft er uns.
priest.en: God tests us, surely he tests us.

priest.de: Mei Rückn, mei Rückn vom vuin Bet.
priest.en: My back, my back from all the praying.

priest.de: Es Dach vo da Kirch tropft scho wieda.
priest.en: The church roof is dripping again.

priest.de: Beten wir fürs Dorf, beten wir.
priest.en: Let us pray for the village, let us pray.

drunk.de: Hicks... no a Schluckerl, no oans...
drunk.en: Hic... just one more sip, one more...
I am not d-d-drunk at all!

drunk.de: Da Mond lacht mi aus, da Mond.
drunk.en: The moon is laughing at me, the moon.

drunk.de: Wer hod do d Gassn so schief baut?
drunk.en: Who built the street so crooked?

drunk.de: Hob i no a Münz? Na, koane.
drunk.en: Have I still a coin? No, none.

drunk.de: Da Wirt schuidet ma no a Bier.
drunk.en: The innkeeper still owes me a beer.

drunk.de: Lalala... de Nacht is no jung...
drunk.en: Lalala... the night is still young...

drunk.de: Mir dreht si olles, olles im Kreis.
Prost, du Hund, auf unsa Dorf!
drunk.en: Cheers, you dog, to our village!

guard.en: My halberd gets heavier all the time.

guard.de: Wer ko do scho um d Zeit aussi sei?
guard.en: Who could be out at this hour?

guard.de: D Wach is lang, da Wein is kurz.
guard.en: The watch is long, the wine is short.

guard.de: I schau no amoi bei da Mauer noch.
guard.en: I will check the wall once more.

guard.de: Mei Fuaß, mei Fuaß, de Stiefl druckn.
guard.en: My foot, my foot, the boots pinch.

guard.de: Da Hauptmo vaschlaft de Wach wieda.
guard.en: The captain sleeps through the watch again.

guard.de: A Nocht wia de ander, hoff i.
guard.en: A night like any other, I hope.

guard.de: Stehnbleibn! Ah na, nur a Katz.
guard.en: Halt! Ah no, only a cat.
When will it finally be morning?

guard.de: Koa Dieb kimmt an mia vorbei.
Es Tor is zua, olles bestens.
guard.en: The gate is shut, all is well.

gravedigger.de: D Erdn is heid wieda stoanhart.
gravedigger.en: The earth is rock hard again today.

gravedigger.de: Mei Schaufe kennt jeden im Dorf.
gravedigger.en: My shovel knows everyone in the village.

gravedigger.de: De Toten red'n wenigstens ned zruck.
gravedigger.en: At least the dead do not talk back.

gravedigger.de: Oana geht, oana kimmt, so is da Lauf.
gravedigger.en: One goes, one comes, such is the way.

gravedigger.de: Heid nacht hob i wos gscharrt ghert.
Kreiz um Kreiz in da Reih.
gravedigger.en: Cross upon cross in a row.

gravedigger.de: A tiafs Loch, a guads Loch.
gravedigger.en: A deep hole, a good hole.
The churchyard soil is rich, rich!

gravedigger.de: Wer zoit mi fia de Nachtschicht?
gravedigger.en: Who pays me for the night shift?

gravedigger.de: I siech olle, aber olle siechn mi ned.
gravedigger.en: I see them all, but nobody sees me.

gravedigger.de: D Wuazln stengan scho wieda im Weg.
gravedigger.en: The roots are in the way again.

elder.en: In the old days it was different...

elder.de: Mei Knia sagt, es werd a Gwitta.
elder.en: My knee says a storm is coming.

elder.de: De Junga hoitn nix mehr aus.
elder.en: The young ones can bear nothing anymore.

elder.de: I hob scho gsehn, wos de ned kenna.
elder.en: I have seen things that they cannot imagine.

elder.de: Heid is a Wedda zum Schlafn.
Wo is mei Stecka, wo is er?
elder.en: Where is my stick, where is it?

elder.de: Aa de Berg ham si veränd'rt.
Mei Oide, Gott hab sie selig...
elder.en: My wife, God rest her soul...

elder.de: A Gschwoabl is des, nix als Gschwoabl.
elder.en: Chatter, that is all it is, only chatter.

elder.de: Des Dorf hod scho Schlimmers erlebt.

elder.en: My back is a weather frog.

mother.de: Wo steckt denn da Bua scho wieda?
mother.en: Where is the boy hiding again?

mother.de: Es Essn werd kolt, kemmts eina!
mother.en: The food is getting cold, come in!

mother.de: Dea Brotteig geht heid ned auf.
mother.en: The bread dough will not rise today.

mother.de: Mei Maxl hod scho wieda a Loch in da Hosn.
mother.en: My little Max has a hole in his trousers again.

mother.de: Wann kimmt da Mo endli hoam?
mother.en: When is my husband coming home at last?

mother.de: Is no a Ei im Stoi, i woaß ned.
mother.en: Is there still an egg in the shed, I do not know.

mother.de: D Wasch muaß no auf d Leinen.
mother.en: The washing still has to go on the line.

mother.de: Schlof guad, mei Schatzl, schlof guad.
mother.en: Sleep well, my little treasure, sleep well.
The neighbour woman has been talking again...

mother.de: Oans fia di, oans fia mi, ois fia d Kinda.
mother.en: One for you, one for me, all for the children.

mother.de: Mei Hend san ganz rau vom Spüln.
mother.en: My hands are quite rough from washing up.

mother.de: Bleib ma ja ned zspat drauß, hearst?
mother.en: Do not stay out too late, you hear?

child.de: Fangas, fangas, du kriagst mi ned!
child.en: Tag, tag, you will not catch me!

child.de: I hob an Fruasch gfonga, an groaßn!
child.en: I caught a frog, a big one!

child.de: Hupf, hupf, hupf, af oam Fuaß...
child.en: Hop, hop, hop, on one foot...

child.de: Wer is da Bluadsauger? I ned, du!
child.en: Who is the bloodsucker? Not me, you!

child.de: Schau, a Stan, a ganz a schöna!
child.en: Look, a stone, such a pretty one!

child.de: Dea Hund hod mi gschleckt, hihi!
I mog ned ins Bett, i mog ned!
child.en: I do not want to go to bed, I do not!

child.de: Mei Kuchl, wer hod mei Kuchl gnumma?
child.en: My cake, who took my cake?

child.de: Da Pfarrer hod a lustige Nosn.
child.en: The priest has a funny nose.

villager.de: Da Wind is heid gscheit kolt.
villager.en: The wind is awfully cold today.

villager.de: Des Brot is wieda teia wordn.
Hast ghert, wos da Müller gsogt hod?
villager.en: Did you hear what the miller said?

villager.de: Da Pfarrer predigt a bissl lang.
villager.en: The priest preaches a bit long.

villager.de: Heid is a guada Tag zum Ausruhn.
villager.en: Today is a good day for resting.

villager.de: Mei Hax tuat weh, de Wetterlag...
Wirt, a Bier, bitte, a koids!
villager.en: Innkeeper, a beer, please, a cold one!

villager.de: Da Nachbar hod wieda a neis Schwein.
villager.en: The neighbour has a new pig again.

villager.de: Oiso, i muaß weida, d Oawat wart.
villager.en: Well, I must get on, work is waiting.

villager.de: Hast de Gschicht vom Gspenst ghert?
villager.en: Have you heard the ghost story?

villager.de: Mei, is des a Wedda, mei, mei.
